shared_elements: horizontal band or register of repeated motifs across the upper area
standing/vertical figural composition on a tall block
raised flat-relief figures with plain background
vertical elongated element (staff/spear-like line) running down the slab
justification: Both are tall stone blocks carved in flat low relief with a horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper zone above the main field, and both use a strongly vertical composition. Beyond that they diverge completely: A shows a single naturalistic, finely detailed human figure with drapery, beard and a long spear, while B is covered with schematic, blocky animal and abstract forms scattered over the surface in a quite different, coarser idiom.
